messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "use with caution in people drinking heavily"
set: ["use with caution in people drinking heavily", "use with caution in people taking tranquilizers or antidepressants", "dose bupropion with caution", "use caution when driving or operating machinery", "avoid drinking alcohol", "drinking kept modest", "drinking too much liquid can be as unsafe as not drinking enough", "amount in body and duration not meaningfully different in people with kidney failure", "read instructions for use with prescription", "discuss grapefruit product use with doctor", "use the dropper supplied with the bottle", "many people with fluid retention respond to intermittent treatment", "consult doctor before changing alcohol consumption if drinking regularly", "avoid drinking alcohol or using medicines that contain alcohol", "additional diuretic therapy for people with significantly reduced kidney function", "may be used in combination with non-nsaid with rapid onset"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
